cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Investment in the Next Round
cards.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.

mechanism: Copy a referee's flag as a competitor and sell the resulting penalty as paid instruction toward winning a later race.
confusable: Not mere positivity about defeat: A must confidently reinterpret a specific copied mistake as intentional future investment.
comparison: Race penalty and free practice differ from a costly retail purchase and future placement advantage.
seedUse: Retains lost entry fee as information investment; replaces abstract exclusive information with a flag penalty and practice start.
